_note: Response plans (incident filters) for the Azure Monitor incident platform. All Review mode. Filters are resource-type or title based to stay as non-overlapping as possible: match order across plans is not documented, and overlapping plans can investigate the same alert twice (AAU cost). Alerts that match no plan are not auto-investigated. Remove the auto-created 'quickstart' plan if present.

responsePlans.name: rp-service-health
responsePlans.useCase: UC04 - Service Health incidents, maintenance, advisories and security incidents correlated with platform changes

responsePlans.useCase: W1 - Resource Health unavailable/degraded on shared platform resources
